question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A thing that can be easily carried by hands
solution:
The correct answer is: **Portable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"thing"** means an object that one need not, cannot, or does not wish to give a specific name to. (वस्तु)

 
 
• **Example: **This thing is very useful for our project.
 
 
 
• **"Carried"** refers to support and move (someone or something) from one place to another. (ले जाना)
 
 
• **Example: **He carried the heavy box to the car.
 
 
 
• **"Portable"** means something that can be easily carried by hands. (पोर्टेबल)
 
 
• **Example: **The portable speaker is easy to carry around.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Portable**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Export** (निर्यात): To send goods or services to another country for sale.

 
 
• **Example:** The company exports its products to various countries around the world.
 
 
 
• **Import** (आयात): To bring goods or services into a country from abroad for sale.
 
 
• **Example:** We import coffee beans from Brazil.
 
 
 
• **Potable** (पेय): Safe to drink; drinkable.
 
 
• **Example:** The water from the well is potable.
